summary: Reviewed all five new weekly candidates independently. Approved 1 completed asset transfer (Cocoli.com). Rejected easyJet and Aroma-Zone as pending/announced, eMAG because completion/closing could not be tied to a reliable official full-date source despite EU approval and media reports, and Bogner as a duplicate of the existing completed row bogner_2025.

approved_deals.buyer: The Platform Group SE & Co. KGaA
approved_deals.direct_owner: The Platform Group SE & Co. KGaA, via acquired assets of the Cocoli.com platform
approved_deals.ultimate_owner: The Platform Group SE & Co. KGaA
approved_deals.one_line_summary: The Platform Group acquired the assets of Berlin-based furniture marketplace Cocoli.com through an asset deal.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: The Platform Group’s official issuer release states that, under a purchase agreement effective on 2026-08-06, the assets of the Cocoli.com platform are transferred as an asset deal. Because the transaction is an asset purchase rather than a share acquisition, the approved row tracks the Cocoli.com platform/assets as owned by The Platform Group SE & Co. KGaA.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Consumer-facing German online furniture marketplace; official issuer evidence on the buyer’s site directly supports an asset transfer on a full ISO-date-convertible publication date, with no later conflicting ownership evidence found.

rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected as pending/announced, not completed. easyJet’s official offer page and the 2026-08-25 extension announcement show a recommended cash acquisition by Eagle Bidco/Apollo, with the scheme document due on or before 2026-10-15 and completion still expected by the end of Q1 2027 subject to conditions.

Rejected for insufficient completion evidence under the gate standard. The European Commission decision dated 2026-08-06 approved and did not oppose the notified operation by which Naspers, via Prosus/MIH, would acquire sole control of eMAG, and Romanian media reported Naspers becoming sole shareholder. However, I did not verify an official/regulator source explicitly confirming closing/completion with a full ISO completion date.

Rejected as pending. Partners Group and Eurazeo described the deal as exclusivity/contemplated on 2026-08-06, and EU/Moroccan competition materials found by search were prior-notification/public-comment materials for a proposed concentration rather than completion evidence.

Rejected as duplicate of existing row bogner_2025. The existing ownership list already contains a completed Bogner 2025 row showing Katjes International via Katjes Quiet Luxury as 60% owner; the official Katjes closing release confirms completion on 2025-09-01.
